title: Allowing Multiple Accounts Under Same Email Address | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Allowing Multiple Accounts Under Same Email Address Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000101330 There is an advanced setting that if enabled, members can have multiple individual accounts with the same email address, but they need different passwords . Go to " Settings " Click on " Advanced Settings " Then search for " Allow Multiple User Accounts with Same Email Addresses " Turn the setting " ON " Click on the " Save " button Alternatively, the Multi-Member Manage r allows you to manage multiple sub accounts from one parent accounts, also using the same email but with different passwords: Multi-Member Manager Add-On For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
